cc:Work.dc:title: Compilation Average History
cc:Work.dc:description: Four distinct scopes retain the full history of compiler-source checking, legacy checked requests, two-program import-inclusive first requests and recent prepared checked compilation. These scopes are not connected. The latest panel includes four-source and three-source observations separately from the latest 23-source P66 baseline and candidate, against the new TypeScript reference. Circles show compile-only ratios; dashed diamonds include import and API loading. The latest equal-source compile-only geometric mean is 1.402065x TypeScript.

Import + API load + first checked request · Evening and Lexer

Bend checking: 205.260 s → 11.156 s · unmatched source snapshots

Line breaks mark changed cohorts, clocks or TS pins. Only P66 covers all 23 sources for B1.
